description: Defines the PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering performance review searches in the OrangeHRM system. Contains constants, properties, and getter/setter methods for filtering criteria such as employee number, review status, date range, and inclusion options.

classes.name: PerformanceReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters for performance reviews, including sorting fields, statuses, employee info, date ranges, and inclusion options.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number filter criterion.
